name: bonsai-garden-rt
_what: Not read by this core (2026-10-18: core takes an rt by rt-minimum.json, a minimum version and its owner's seal, never by a hash). Kept only because rt 0.8.3 and older read it: their garden MCP's exec gate refuses to start without it (tools/bonsai-mcp/signer.py, core_gate), and their doctor notes it. It goes, on the gardener's word, once no such rt serves a garden on this host (the Studio's own MCP runs rt 0.8.3 until rt 0.8.4 is cut and installed).
